title: Hope
coreMove: Rewrite a setback from permanent identity evidence into a specific problem to work.
sourcePressure: Define hope as belief that effort can improve the future after failure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating hope as optimism, mood, or waiting for luck.

sourceAnchors.name: Seligman and Maier learned helplessness experiments
sourceAnchors.detail: Dogs with control over shocks were more likely to escape later shocks, while uncontrollable adversity taught helplessness.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The barrier matters because hope is learned in the moment a body discovers its action can change the outcome.

sourceAnchors.name: Duckworth neurobiology course
sourceAnchors.detail: After failing two early tests, she stayed in the college neurobiology course, changed her effort, and finished with a B.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The failed tests did not become a verdict because she treated them as a problem still open to effort.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
